banners.prompt:
Create a square bonus graphic for a sales page, FULL BLEED: the coloured background fills the whole square edge to edge, no white margins, no borders, no frame, no empty white space.
BACKGROUND: dark teal #0E3B43 with a soft warm glow; title in white with the second line in orange.
LAYOUT: text block in the upper half, left-aligned with about 7% margins; a large, attractive 3D-style visual in the lower half: a small beagle-like puppy sitting in a cosy dog bed next to a printed checklist sheet with seven ticked boxes, a chew toy and a water bowl.
TEXT (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Small label at the top, orange pill with dark teal text: "🎁 БОНУС"
2) Title line 1, very big: "ПЪРВИТЕ 7 ДНИ"
3) Title line 2, very big: "С НОВОТО КУЧЕНЦЕ"
4) Subtitle, medium: "чеклист ден по ден"
Text must be BIG: the title lines take about 30% of the image height in total.

STYLE: premium, warm, friendly, modern; clean professional design like a bestselling publisher would use. Palette: dark teal #0E3B43, warm orange #F28C28, light mint #E3F4EE and white.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic except "L.E.A.S.H.". Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation and quotation marks. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Heavy, clean sans-serif with full Cyrillic (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black style) for titles; clean regular sans-serif for the subtitle. Large and clearly legible on a phone.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices, author names or website addresses anywhere.
DOGS: ordinary friendly family dogs like Bulgarians keep (mixed breed, beagle-like, labrador-like, small terrier), not exotic breeds; natural anatomy, four legs, correct eyes and paws. NO people anywhere, no faces; if a hand appears it is gender-neutral (no nail polish, no jewellery, no sleeve), five fingers.
